fields.name: Human-readable pack name.
fields.family: launcher, comic, faction, command-card, info-comic, studio-layer-forge, game-ui, or future family.
fields.status: design-seed, TEST, WORKING, CANON only when approved.
fields.targetNamespace: Where the pack is intended to live, for example /assets/packs/launcher/base/.
fields.assets: Array of asset references. Each item should name a ref and status.
fields.templates: Template ids used by this pack.
fields.noFakeDone: Known missing pieces or limits. Required.

principle: STABLE SHELL. FLEXIBLE SLOTS. PROTECTED OUTPUT.
